extraction.target: Mean observed pressure indicator in the supplied eligible rookie rush cohort; conditional, not unconditional career success.
extraction.onset_weights: Equal source-only sensitivity scenarios .5,1,2 yd/s; not calibrated phase probabilities
extraction.frame_scope: Up to first 61 contiguous 10Hz active frames. Gaps rejected. Four operational ordered phase templates, not labeled physiology.

numerical_scope: Exact integer populations and ranks; binary64 log-weight inference and source observations. Rational reference API checked on small graphs.
formal_scope: Uses the finite partial-state language framework developed in ArithmeticModes. New numerical compiler, feature extraction and NFL regression are not formally verified.
summary: The reusable engine evaluates all allowed phase segmentations and event-order features. The first private-data experiment covers 361 drill attempts, 74 players and 1,083 onset scenarios. A combined model improves exploratory 2025 pressure-rate error by 7.7%, but performs worse in earlier-cohort nested tests; a stable scouting gain is not established.

cases.scope: Synthetic fixed observation weights; population and rank exact, posteriors floating.
